headline: Vanderbilt leads the SEC with one defeat all season
dek: Vanderbilt has won 17 matches and drawn one, and its lone defeat came against Texas, a side it had already beaten at home. It has scored 63 goals and conceded 12, and it has yet to lose a conference match.

pattern.label: observed
pattern.text: The short bars are not the soft sides: Auburn has scored 24 and conceded only six, and has drawn eight of its matches.

wire.line: South Carolina's Christina Tsaousis has kept eleven shutouts this season.

validation.policy: observed and derived claims are recomputed against the data home before publish; failures are dropped, not softened. signal and projected pass on schema unless the data contradicts a figure. context is never validated as a finding.
